summary: A library advisory board member argues that eliminating E‑Rate subsidies would force library branches to close or cut hours, threatening public access.

claims.argument: Eliminating E‑Rate would force library branches to close or cut hours, reducing public access to library services.
claims.evidence_quote: If E-Rate subsidies go away, the only way to make up the funds for my hometown library(19 branches) is from staff salaries. Already bare minimum staff. Branches will have to close cutting service
